board: Adafruit MCP23008 i2c 8 input/output port expander (product 593, bare MCP23008-E/P PDIP-18 chip; same as SparkFun COM-15099)
reason: Check PASSED on ESP32 and Pico (wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator example: GP7 button with pull-up read via GPIO 0x09 lights GP0 via OLAT 0x0A, PCB DRC clean, DIP-18 footprint, LCSC C646745). No widely sold MCP23008 header breakout exists, so the bare DIP chip is modelled with pins 1-18 per the datasheet; A0-A2 are tied to GND (address 0x20) and RESET to VDD, and 4.7k SDA/SCL pull-ups are declared.
breakoutPinoutSource: Microchip DS20001919F Table 1-1 / Package Types (PDIP-18 pin order); Adafruit product 593 page (DIP package, 2.7-5.5 V)
